title: Boldine promotes stemness of human urine-derived stem cells by activating the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway.
authors: Qiao, Yinggu; Shen, Liangliang; Zhang, Yixue; Zhou, Ming; Sun, Zhenxiao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子boldine通过Wnt/β-catenin通路维持尿源干细胞干性，仅涉及分子对接预测GSK-3β抑制，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Human urine-derived stem cells (hUSCs) process self-renewal and multilineage differentiation ability. Due to their non-invasive and easily available clinical source, hUSCs represent a promising alternative source of mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) for application potential in cytotherapy. However, technical limitations, such as stemness property maintenance, have hindered hUSCs' clinical application. Certain some small molecules have been recognized with advantage in maintaining the stemness of stem cells. In this study, we identified stemness-regulated key targets of hUSCs based on the StemCellNet database, CMAP database and literature mining. Furthermore, we identified a small molecule compound, boldine, which may have the potential to promote the stemness of hUSCs. It promotes cell proliferation, multilineage differentiation and maintains stemness of hUSCs by cell viability assay, single-cell clone formation, osteogenic differentiation and stemness marker expression (OCT-4 and C-MYC). We identified that boldine may be a potential GSK-3beta inhibitor by molecular docking and confirmed that it can upregulate the level of beta-catenin and promote translocation of beta-catenin into nucleus of hUSCs using Western blotting and immunofluorescence analysis. Our study indicates boldine activates the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway in hUSCs and provides an effective strategy for MSCs research and application of small molecules in maintaining the stemness of hUSCs.
abstract_zh: 人尿源性干细胞（hUSCs）具有自我更新和多向分化能力。由于其非侵入性且临床来源易于获取，hUSCs 代表了一种有前景的间充质干细胞（MSCs）替代来源，在细胞治疗中具有应用潜力。然而，技术限制，如干性维持，阻碍了 hUSCs 的临床应用。某些小分子已被认为在维持干细胞干性方面具有优势。在本研究中，我们基于 StemCellNet 数据库、CMAP 数据库和文献挖掘，鉴定了 hUSCs 的干性调控关键靶点。此外，我们确定了一种小分子化合物——波尔定（boldine），其可能具有促进 hUSCs 干性的潜力。通过细胞活力测定、单细胞克隆形成、成骨分化和干性标志物表达（OCT-4 和 C-MYC），我们发现它促进细胞增殖、多向分化并维持 hUSCs 的干性。通过分子对接，我们确定波尔定可能是潜在的 GSK-3beta 抑制剂，并利用 Western blotting 和免疫荧光分析证实其能上调 beta-catenin 水平并促进 beta-catenin 转位至 hUSCs 细胞核。我们的研究表明，波尔定激活 hUSCs 中的 Wnt/beta-catenin 信号通路，并为 MSCs 研究及小分子在维持 hUSCs 干性中的应用提供了有效策略。
